_comment: GPU provider roster. Keep credentials out of this file; only environment-variable names belong here.

candidates.name: nosana
candidates.activation_requirement: Verify current account credits, API contract, supported workload path, and zero-cost credit policy before activation.

candidates.name: huggingface_zerogpu
candidates.activation_requirement: Use only as a provider-specific adapter for Spaces/ZeroGPU; do not treat it as a generic GPU rental API.

notes: Providers become live only after their API contract and credential have been verified.
compute_probe adapters are provider-specific and must not assume a common GPU API.
NOVA may record degraded or unavailable provider state without deleting the provider configuration.
